source: Recipe rewards whose recipe-book row is missing from the shipped tables (Global deleted them), so the recipe can't be granted or crafted. exvius_rewards.parse pays the item the recipe crafted instead (operator's request, 2026-11-09). Built by hand from a search of every reward field the server pays (first clears, challenges of served quests, town quests, exchanges, Parade/raid rewards): the item a recipe crafted comes from an older snapshot of Global's recipes.json (aEnigmatic/ffbe history) where it survives, else from the equipment of the same name; where two exist, the version Global's later re-release recipe crafts. The '+' festival items aren't in the tables at all, so the plain version stands in. Missing recipes in content this server doesn't serve (152 challenge rewards of quests Global never ran, the season-event 'collab' rows) are not listed.
